title: DATESYTD over a range of dates starts at January 1 and ends at the last selected date
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( VAR R = DATESYTD ( 'Date'[Date] ) RETURN ROW ( "Min", MINX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Max", MAXX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Days", COUNTROWS ( R ), "Sales", CALCULATE ( [Sales], R ) ), 'Date'[Date] >= DATE ( 2024, 2, 5 ) && 'Date'[Date] <= DATE ( 2024, 5, 20 ) )

source.quote: If the selection contains larger periods, it returns the YTD using
Returns a set of dates in the year up to the last date visible in the filter context.
source.supports: DATESYTD goes from January 1 to the last visible date

derivation: The last selected date is 2024-05-20; the start of the selection (February 5) does not matter. January 1 to May 20, 2024 is 31 + 29 + 31 + 30 + 20 = 141 days. Sales: Jan 300 + Feb 700 + Mar 500 + May 20 600 = 2100.
